mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'PARENT'

WITH latest_report AS ( SELECT asset_report_id, child_id, total_asset_amount, total_asset_change_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY child_id ORDER BY report_month DESC, asset_report_id DESC ) AS row_seq FROM asset_report WHERE child_id = #{childId} ), primary_goal AS ( SELECT fg.financial_goal_id, fg.child_id, fg.title, fg.target_amount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN fa.balance ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS saved_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fg.child_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN fg.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, fg.target_date, fg.financial_goal_id ) AS row_seq FROM financial_goal fg LEFT JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_goal_id = fg.financial_goal_id LEFT JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = fga.financial_account_id WHERE fg.child_id = #{childId} AND fg.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') GROUP BY fg.financial_goal_id, fg.child_id, fg.title, fg.target_amount, fg.status, fg.target_date ), nearest_capsule AS ( SELECT time_capsule_id, child_id, title, DATEDIFF(expected_release_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS d_day, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY child_id ORDER BY expected_release_at, time_capsule_id ) AS row_seq FROM time_capsule WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'COLLECTING' AND expected_release_at IS NOT NULL AND expected_release_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.name AS childName, c.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl,
COALESCE( lr.total_asset_amount, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fa.balance), 0) FROM financial_account fa WHERE fa.child_id = c.child_id AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AS totalAssetAmount,
COALESCE(lr.total_asset_change_amount, 0) AS totalAssetChangeAmount,
pg.financial_goal_id AS primaryGoalId, pg.title AS primaryGoalTitle, pg.saved_amount AS primaryGoalSavedAmount, pg.target_amount AS primaryGoalTargetAmount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial_goal fg WHERE fg.child_id = c.child_id AND fg.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS activeGoalCount,
nc.time_capsule_id AS nearestTimeCapsuleId, nc.title AS nearestTimeCapsuleTitle, nc.d_day AS nearestTimeCapsuleDDay,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_checklist_item cci WHERE cci.child_id = c.child_id ) AS checklistTotalCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_checklist_item cci WHERE cci.child_id = c.child_id AND cci.status = 'COMPLETED' ) AS checklistCompletedCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n WHERE n.member_id = #{memberId} AND n.is_read = 0 ) AS unreadNotificationCount
FROM child c LEFT JOIN latest_report lr ON lr.child_id = c.child_id AND lr.row_seq = 1 LEFT JOIN primary_goal pg ON pg.child_id = c.child_id AND pg.row_seq = 1 LEFT JOIN nearest_capsule nc ON nc.child_id = c.child_id AND nc.row_seq = 1 WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_month, '%Y-%m') AS reportMonth, total_asset_amount AS totalAssetAmount FROM asset_report WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY report_month DESC, asset_report_id DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT cci.child_checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, cit.title AS title, cci.status AS status FROM child_checklist_item cci JOIN checklist_item_template cit ON cit.checklist_item_template_id = cci.checklist_item_template_id WHERE cci.child_id = #{childId} AND cit.is_active = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN cci.status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cit.item_order, cci.child_checklist_item_id LIMIT #{limit}
